About

Hi, I'm Krish Nukala, a Sr. Application Engineer based in Nashville, TN with 9+ years of experience building enterprise BI platforms and data systems in healthcare. My work sits at the crossroads of Business Intelligence, System Engineering and Emerging AI.

At HCA Healthcare — one of the largest health systems in the US — in my current role I independently led the migration of the Mobile Heartbeat platform from Tableau to Power BI, contributed to an enterprise Teradata-to-GCP cloud migration, and supported a large-scale MicroStrategy Cloud transition.

I hold a Master's in Computer Science from Kent State University and have published research with the Tennessee Department of Health. I'm actively expanding into AI engineering — combining deep healthcare domain knowledge with modern AI tooling.

Outside of work I maintain the Nukala Family Archive — a personal passion project preserving our family's heritage. Built a complete family archive web application entirely from scratch — 16 pages, zero hosting cost, production-grade features. The project demonstrates end-to-end full-stack ownership from domain registration to AI integration.
